D: A popular Beverly Hills teen plays matchmaker and gives a new girl a makeover.
P: Serve the mains when Cher gives Tai her makeover.
S: heirloom tomato, torn creamy cheese, basil oil and balsamic on sourdough, from far away it's OK

Heirloom tomatoes, torn burrata, basil oil and balsamic with chargrilled sourdough. Blend half the basil with 60ml of the olive oil and a pinch of salt for the basil oil. Cut the tomatoes into wedges and rounds, salt them and leave for 10 minutes. Slice the sourdough, brush with the rest of the oil and toast in a hot grill pan until charred, then rub with the cut garlic. Lay the tomatoes on a platter, tear the burrata over, spoon on the basil oil and balsamic and scatter the rest of the basil. Serve with the toast.
Lime guacamole and fresh tomato salsa with a bag of corn chips

Corn chips with guacamole (avocado mashed with lime, onion, coriander and chilli) and a fresh salsa of diced tomato, onion and lime. Mash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes, finely chopped onion, coriander and a little chilli. Dice 3 tomatoes with onion and lime juice for salsa. Serve both with a 300g bag of corn chips.
Warm soft pretzels rolled in cinnamon sugar, with a sweet cream cheese dip
Soft pretzels brushed with melted butter, rolled in cinnamon sugar, warmed at 200C for 5 minutes, with a cream cheese icing dip.
M: Mel's grilled snapper with salsa verde
Cher's cholesterol rules for Daddy, no fat

Snapper fillets grilled skin side down until the skin crackles, a sharp parsley, caper and lemon salsa verde, and a crunchy green salad with avocado. Pat 4 snapper fillets (about 160g each) dry and score the skin. Chop 1 bunch parsley, half a bunch mint, 1 tbsp capers and 1 garlic clove, then mix with 100ml olive oil, the juice of 1 lemon and salt. Heat a heavy pan over high heat with 1 tbsp oil, lay the fish in skin side down, press for 10 seconds and cook 4 minutes until crisp, then flip for 1 minute. Toss 150g mixed leaves, 1 sliced Lebanese cucumber and 1 sliced avocado with a little of the salsa. Serve the fish with salsa verde spooned over.
Sushi rice topped with sashimi salmon, avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger

Sushi rice in bowls with salmon, avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger, soy and sesame dressing. Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar and sugar. Top bowls with 400g sliced sashimi salmon, sliced avocado, cucumber, 200g edamame and pickled ginger. Dress with soy mixed with a little sesame oil.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with pink and white buttercream and sprinkles

Vanilla cupcakes baked at 180C for 18 minutes, cooled, piped with pastel strawberry and vanilla buttercream and finished with sprinkles. Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, blend some with mashed strawberry for pink, pipe and add sprinkles.
K: Rodeo Drive mango and strawberry smoothie
Mango, strawberry and banana blended thick with orange juice

Ripe mango, strawberries and banana blitzed with fresh orange juice and ice into a thick, bright sunset smoothie, served in tall glasses with striped straws. Peel and chop 1 large mango and hull 250g strawberries. Put them in a blender with 1 banana, 500ml cold orange juice, 100g Greek yoghurt and 2 cups of ice. Blend on high for 45 seconds until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall glasses, perch a strawberry on each rim and serve with striped straws.
